result.summary: The intersection features a wide multi-lane roadway with faded zebra-style crosswalk markings and overhead traffic signals. A large truck parked near the crossing creates a significant visual obstruction, and the lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals or curb extensions increases risk for those crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white truck is parked very close to the crosswalk on the left, blocking sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk paint is significantly worn and degraded, making the crossing less conspicuous to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island at the immediate crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness and crossing visibility.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk but lacks signalization or stop control. While a sidewalk and curb ramps are present on the left, the right side appears to lack a paved walkway, and the long crossing distance without a refuge island increases pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal or stop sign on a wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the zebra crossing

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk Connection
hazards.description: The right side of the road lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians onto unpaved surfaces or into the roadway after crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway beyond the crossing

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to the crossing to increase driver awareness and yielding rates at this uncontrolled location.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the road to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

result.summary: The image shows a large, multi-lane arterial intersection with a commercial land use context. Pedestrian infrastructure is sparse, featuring long crossing distances across at least four lanes of traffic with no visible refuge islands or dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic over a long distance without a refuge.

hazards.name: Faded Markings
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are faint, reducing visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Use continental markings to improve visibility for approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance by extending the curb at the corners, which also slows turning vehicles.

result.summary: The environment features a wide multi-lane arterial road with a grassy median and residential land use. While marked crosswalks, sidewalks, and traffic signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals create a car-centric environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic on a wide arterial road, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white truck parked near the corner may block sightlines between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Convert the existing grassy median into a raised pedestrian refuge island to allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve clarity for crossing pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking of large vehicles near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.
